name: critical_premises
description: Track a bounded key premise controlling the main answer, choice, mutation, or external action. Status is model-derived; syntax-only provisional output is not factual support. The driver binds references to actual current-turn tool observations before retaining a runtime receipt.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later critical_premises calls in this turn:
- Use only material premises whose failure changes the main answer, choice, mutation, or external action. Keep at most 8 IDs; update an existing ID rather than creating duplicates. IDs are 1..64 ASCII letters/digits/_.-. All string limits are UTF-8 byte limits; an update allows at most 8192 string bytes total.
- Provide the precise proposition and controlling impact. Dependencies must already exist, cannot include self/duplicates, and must remain acyclic. Changing a premise invalidates its transitive dependents to pending until reevaluated. A changed proposition/impact or supported object scope must first be pending/limited, then explicitly reevaluated.
- Evidence uses exact current-turn tool_call_id and driver-established object tokens. Do not invent object provenance from a model label or command text. Supported requires every reference to have full coverage and bind to a known successful complete result for that exact object, with all dependencies supported and no open gap/conflict. Unknown/future/self-update references are errors; failed, truncated, partial, unknown-outcome or mismatched observations cannot support.
- Use limited with an explicit gap/scope limitation when evidence cannot certify the requested scope; limited is closed rather than silently supported. Pending, refuted and limited remain model-derived dispositions and may carry negative/partial observations. A runtime receipt certifies evidence identity/outcome/completeness, not the proposition's semantic truth.
- request_review only requests consideration: eligibility requires pending plus a material gap/conflict and at least one actual verification attempt (failure/partial is allowed). Reviewer text is not new evidence and never upgrades status. No session-global premise state is retained.

object.description: Exact driver-established observed object token; unknown provenance cannot certify support.

gap.description: Open gap or explicit scope limitation; required and nonempty for limited.
